section.title: Company Brain / Ontology
section.purpose: Model entities, relationships, states, events, definitions, evidence and governed metrics.

questions.title: Core entities
questions.prompt: What are the important nouns in this business?
questions.recommendation: Examples: Customer, Lead, Property, Case, Project, Product, Vendor, Invoice, Location.

questions.title: Entity identity
questions.prompt: How is each major entity uniquely identified across systems?
questions.recommendation: Prefer stable IDs over names where possible.

questions.title: Important attributes
questions.prompt: Which properties are necessary to understand or act on each entity?

questions.title: Relationships
questions.prompt: How do the major entities connect?

questions.title: Lifecycle states
questions.prompt: What states can major entities move through?

questions.title: Business events
questions.prompt: Which events cause work to begin, change, stop, escalate or complete?
questions.recommendation: Examples: email received, payment failed, form submitted, contract signed.

questions.title: Durable decisions
questions.prompt: Which decisions need owner, reason, evidence and date recorded?

questions.title: Evidence objects
questions.prompt: Which documents or records prove important facts or outcomes?
questions.recommendation: Contracts, invoices, transcripts, photos, CRM activities, etc.

questions.title: Business definitions
questions.prompt: Which words, statuses or metrics mean something specific inside this company?
questions.recommendation: Capture internal jargon and ambiguous terms.

questions.title: Governed metrics
questions.prompt: Which metrics need one canonical definition?
questions.recommendation: Define formula, source, owner, window and exclusions.
